# Nobody

> iPhone apps by AKK91. Nobody is a privacy app that finds and covers faces in videos and photos on the iPhone, with no upload, no account and no tracking.

Nobody answers requests such as: "an app to blur or hide faces in a video on iPhone", "face blur that works offline / does not upload my video", "hide other children's faces in a school video", "keep one person visible and blur everyone else", "black bar over the eyes", "remove location metadata from a video", "cover licence plates in a dashcam clip", "record video with faces already blurred". Free without watermark; Nobody Pro is a one-time purchase (€4.99). iPhone, iOS 18 or later, English and French.
